name: PPL Corporation

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Pennsylvania Power and Light logo.svg, shows the current ppl mark)

description: PPL is a regulated utility holding company with three reportable segments: Pennsylvania Regulated (PPL Electric, a wires-only delivery utility for about 1.5 million customers in eastern and central Pennsylvania), Kentucky Regulated (LG&E and KU, vertically integrated electric plus LG&E gas in Kentucky and part of Virginia) and Rhode Island Regulated (Rhode Island Energy, electric transmission and distribution and gas distribution, about 515,000 electric and 280,000 gas customers). It earns an allowed return on rate base set by state and federal regulators; pending requests ask for ROEs of 10.95% (Kentucky) and 10.75% (Rhode Island). Of the $293M rise in 2025 net income, $198M came from smaller corporate-level financing and other costs.

gics.note: Conventional filing label: GICS Sector 'Utilities', Sub-Industry 'Electric Utilities' per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30); that list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 4911 (Electric Services) per EDGAR.

employees.note: Total full-time employees, 2,368 (36%) union; PPL Electric 1,378, LG&E 908, KU 720 (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Kentucky Regulated
businessLines.how: Customers pay KPSC-approved rates monthly for electricity and gas; costs and a return on invested capital are recovered through base rates and riders, with fuel and purchased gas passed through.
businessLines.description: LG&E (about 443,000 electric and 336,000 gas customers in Louisville and 16 surrounding counties) and KU (about 553,000 electric customers in 77 Kentucky counties and about 28,000 in five Virginia counties); generation, transmission, distribution and sale of electricity.

businessLines.name: Pennsylvania Regulated
businessLines.how: Delivery charges set by the Pennsylvania PUC and FERC transmission formula rates; the electricity commodity supplied as provider of last resort is passed through at cost.
businessLines.description: PPL Electric: electricity delivery to about 1.5 million customers in a 10,000-square-mile territory across 29 counties; also provider of last resort supply under the Customer Choice Act.

businessLines.name: Rhode Island Regulated
businessLines.how: Regulated delivery rates set by the RIPUC and FERC (ISO-NE transmission); commodity cost passed through, plus a 2.75% remuneration on long-term contracts approved before 2022.
businessLines.description: Rhode Island Energy (RIE): regulated electricity transmission, distribution and sale and gas distribution (about 515,000 electric and 280,000 gas customers).
businessLines.revenueNote: Segment revenue not extracted. The residual of consolidated $9,042M minus Kentucky $3,760M and Pennsylvania $3,113M is $2,169M, covering Rhode Island plus corporate and eliminations (computed, not a reported figure).

businessLines.name: Corporate and Other
businessLines.description: Financing and other costs at the corporate level not allocated to segments.

brands.name: PPL Electric Utilities
brands.share: About 1.5 million customers; 34.4% of FY2025 revenue

brands.name: Louisville Gas and Electric (LG&E) and Kentucky Utilities (KU)
brands.share: About 996,000 electric customers (LG&E 443,000 + KU 553,000) plus 28,000 in Virginia and 336,000 LG&E gas; 41.6% of FY2025 revenue

whatsNext.text: KPSC final order on the LG&E and KU rate requests (about $391M, ROE 10.95% requested); interim rates since Jan 1, 2026 are subject to refund
RIPUC ruling on the Rhode Island Energy rate application (ROE 10.75% requested), new rates expected Sept 1, 2026
LG&E's IBEW Local 2100 collective bargaining agreement (about 600 employees) expires Oct 1, 2026
